title: Machine learning-based screening of sarcopenia in elderly women using non-invasive physiological signals.
summary: SVM, neural-network, random-forest and gradient-boosting models screen sarcopenia from ECG, EMG and center-of-pressure signals in elderly Korean women.

Full Methods/Results in NCBI PMC BioC; physiological-signal features, AWGS reference criteria and stratified cross-validation reviewed.
